To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed and implemented a process mining tool and framework, Niriksha, to discover process maps, inefficiency and inconsistencies from the issue report data of an open source project.
the design time process model and the runtime process map of issue resolution process are different and the design time model can be improved by considering the runtime process map.
we have implemented a process mining framework to analyze issue tracking system event logs and discovered process maps, inefficiency and inconsistencies.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: What is the runtime process map? What are the inefficiencies? How do we measure the conformance? What are the insights? We present the Nirikshan framework, a process mining framework to discover process maps, inefficiency and inconsistencies from bug report history.
the discovery of runtime process maps, process inefficiencies and inconsistencies in issue management activities from the event log data of an issue tracking system.
the application of process mining techniques for analyzing the issue reporting to resolution workflow in an open-source project.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
process mining can be effectively used for discovering runtime process maps and inefficiencies in issue reporting process.
process mining is a useful tool for discovering and analyzing process inefficiencies and inconsistencies, and to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Nirikshan can be used by the software maintenance teams to discover the process of issue reporting and resolution from the bug report history, identify inefficiencies in the process and compare the design time and runtime process models to find inconsistencies and gaps.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
process mining is a powerful tool for discovering and analyzing business processes from data generated by process aware information systems.
process mining is a powerful technique to analyze the bug report history data and discover runtime process maps.
process mining can be used to discover process inefficiencies and inconsistencies and to measure the conformance between the designed and actual process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
business process mining tools can be used to analyze issue tracking systems and provide insights to improve the process and quality of issue management.

business process mining can be applied to issue tracking systems and process mining can provide valuable insights to the project team for discovering and analyzing process inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and inconsistencies.

process mining can provide insights on the runtime process of bug management in an issue tracking system and the process mining results can be used to enhance process design and improve process efficiency.
